articles.title: Tokenization and stablecoins may weather Democrats' sweep as broader crypto rules face uncertainty
articles.snippet: Wall Street's push to bring finance onto blockchain rails may continue under existing laws, though the SEC and CFTC face tougher oversight and questions over how long their rules will last, experts said.

articles.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

articles.title: France budget rejection sidelines stablecoin tax, wallet reporting
articles.snippet: Three adopted amendments, including stablecoin taxation and self-custody reporting, fall away but could be reintroduced in the Senate.

articles.title: Circle’s ARC token sale lifts earnings as lower yields weigh on USDC income
articles.snippet: Circle is looking to payments fees and future staking rewards to diversify revenue as its core stablecoin business faces pressure from lower yields and growing competition.

articles.title: Stablecoins Go Mainstream as Samsung Wallet Adds USDC on Solana
articles.snippet: Eligible U.S. Galaxy users can now buy, hold, send and receive USDC on Solana directly in Samsung Wallet, without a separate crypto app or private keys to manage.
